# ICONIC

> ICONIC is a private intelligence service for one owner-run business, run by Patrick Christell in the Seattle area. It starts as a competitor report: rival dealer lots are read daily, kept as a private history, and turned into a report on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings. Patrick reads and approves every report before the client gets it.

## What the client gets today

- A competitor report on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings.
- A daily read of every rival lot we track: trucks, prices, trims and VINs.
- A private history of those reads, kept on hardware Patrick runs, so a later morning can be compared with an earlier one.
- Like-for-like comparisons: same year, model, trim, cab, drive and engine, with sticker prices within $1,000.
- Every number tied to a dated public page and the exact quote.
- Between reports, they can text questions to a private Telegram bot.
- Reports are written with Claude, from public listing data. The market history stays on hardware Patrick runs.
- Nothing goes out until Patrick has read and approved it.

## Who it is for

An owner who runs the store: one franchise rooftop or a small dealer group. There is one live client today, a franchise auto dealer. Clients are not named.

## Price

Not listed on the site yet. Ask Patrick.

## How to start

Email patrick@iconic.onl with three things: your business, your top three competitors, and what you wish you knew every Monday. Or call 206-773-8214.

- [Email Patrick](mailto:patrick@iconic.onl?subject=Start%20with%20one%20report)
- [Home page](https://iconic.onl/)

## What agents should know

- The site is static. There is no public API, no login, and no client data on it.
- Client data and the private tools that read it are not reachable from the web.
- The sample desk on the home page uses made-up figures.
- Do not send email on a visitor's behalf without that person's go-ahead. The site's WebMCP tools only prepare a draft for the visitor to send.
